scope: Reconcile the legacy four-label vocabulary in configs/eq45_source_contract.json with the canonical four-class governance vocabulary and with the independently callable autonomous Eq45 supported delivery. This contract changes no velocity value, source formula, candidate identity, scientific threshold, or delivery state.

canonical_classification_vocabulary.user_requirement: A requirement explicitly imposed by the user/project delivery contract.
canonical_classification_vocabulary.public_source_fact: A fact directly supported by a public source with provenance retained.
canonical_classification_vocabulary.autonomous_design: A repository-side parameter, profile, transform, diagnostic, or engineering choice not claimed as public-source data.
canonical_classification_vocabulary.pending_unknown: A numerical datum, identity, or claim not established by available evidence.

eq45_source_items.item_prefix: Eq. (4.1) similarity coordinates and Eq. (4.5) leading Cartesian velocity formula
callable velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w] as the immediate engineering deliverable
finite numerical choices such as h, sigma, radial degree, eta nodes, fit weights and visualization tolerances
final numerical profile data identifying the OpenAI field and full exterior/correction coefficients

source_to_delivery_bridge.interpretation: There is no contradiction between the source contract leaving the final public-source numerical profiles unresolved and the repository delivering a callable/saveable autonomous numerical field built on the sourced Eq. (4.5) backbone. The latter satisfies the engineering delivery requirement but does not resolve the former.

forbidden_inferences: Do not reinterpret the legacy label public_source as meaning that autonomous h/profile/taper/time choices are published OpenAI numerical data.
Do not reinterpret final_profiles_numerically_identified=false as meaning that no callable repository velocity field can be delivered.
Do not reinterpret canonical velocity_export_ready=true as source-level recovery of the hidden OpenAI profiles or the complete corrected theorem field.

Do not set unresolved public-source profile data to zero merely to create a source-only numerical field; the delivered numerical field must retain explicit autonomous provenance for its chosen profiles and parameters.
Do not promote visual resemblance, exportability, green CI, or Eq. (4.5) ancestry into visual_correspondence_verified, pde_validated, paper_exact, or openai_field_identified.
